s: Which of the following statement is correct regarding ' Impatiens Karuppusamyi ', seen in the news recently?
o: A new aquatic flora discovered by the National Institute of Oceanography (NIO) in Thamirabarani river of Tamil Nadu
A new species of Hoof fungus grown on plant species discovered by the Botanical Survey of India (BSI) in Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve
A new species of Bamboo-dwelling bat discovered by Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) in Madumalai Tiger Reserve
A new species of plant discovered by researchers of Botanical Survey of India (BSI) in Kalakad Mundanthurai Tiger Reserve
x: Impatiens karuppusamyi is a new balsam species (genus Impatiens, Balsaminaceae) described by Botanical Survey of India researchers from Kalakad Mundanthurai Tiger Reserve, so option 4 is right. The other options wrongly describe it as aquatic flora, a fungus or a bat.

s: The Embassy of which country applied for a GI Tag for 'Nihonshu' for the first time in India?
o: More than one of the above
x: In 2022, the Embassy of Japan, New Delhi has filed an application seeking a Geographical Indication (GI) Tag for Nihonshu/Japanese sake. This is first time a product from Japan has filed for a tag at the Geographical Indication Registry. In 2024, it was approved for GI Tag in India. In Japan, Nihonshu is regarded as a special and valuable beverage made from fermenting rice.
